approaches.description: Finite-p symmetry and normalized subsequential limits
approaches.outcome: Our asymmetric examples are nonselected; transitive-ridge special case; general p-limit remains unresolved.

finite_checks_role: Corroboration only; proof is analytic. Initial author smoke test used python -I -S; frozen acceptance replay uses separately pinned pre-execution inventory.
p_limit_question: Unresolved in general by this work; symmetry obstruction excludes our asymmetric examples from finite-p limits; transitive-ridge special case follows from established compactness and uniqueness.
publication_boundary: Authored proof, authored code/results, status and public metadata only; no source documents, extracts, corpus contents or private coordination.
representation_question: Candidate negative answer proved directly for every domain with at least two high-ridge points; counterexample on a connected convex Lipschitz rectangle for every 0<alpha<=1. Singleton exhaustiveness relies on cited known result.
